appearanceScope.notes: Draft limited to this photographed appearance. Does not cover every CL generation, year, trim or drivetrain. Near-side category illustration shows two visible wheel assemblies; far-side assemblies are not illustrated. Mechanical assemblies are representative, not OEM fitment evidence.
